newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains end down after stg-led gains lost.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains end down after stg-led gains lost.

text.p: LIFFE grains ended marginally lower and well off the day's highs, as tired sentiment offset the effects of an easier sterling, traders said.
November was the most active month on wheat, with 283 of a total 816 contracts traded. It last changed hands 0.25 stg lower at 100.60 stg.
But it hit a high earlier of 101.50 stg, on sterling losses against the mark, but then surprised by coming back "The general sentiment is that the market has had enough," one trader said.
Signs later in the day that sterling was starting to recover helped scrub off the earlier gains, he said.
Old crop contracts were much less volatile. May last traded 0.15 stg lower at 98.75 stg, not so far off its high of 99.00.
The May-July spread at 3.20 stg is the widest it has been, the trader pointed out. "People just don't want the May as it goes towards tendering," he said. The first tender date for May is April 24.
